slides.title: Silent Reading
slides.body:
No Talking

Today is silent reading. The theme is witches and magic.

Choose a reading from the back shelf: A2, B1, B2, or C1.

You have 36 minutes to read. The boxed line number is the target. But keep reading past this if you can.

You will have 10 minutes at the end to answer a question about the story.
slides.notes: Start the timer when students have chosen their books. The timer beeps at 1 minute remaining and rings the bell at 36:00.

slides.title: Writing Task
slides.body:
Write as much as you can in 10 minutes. Answer this question:

What was the best part of this story? Why did you enjoy it?

Opinion — Reason — Example

You will receive a grade for this writing. This will go in your gradebook.
slides.notes: Students answer the question about the story they read. Structure: Opinion, Reason, Example.
